headline: Barry Callebaut Flavourcode and Planet A cocoa replacers; Roquette, Palsgaard; US UPF and dye rules
summary: Barry Callebaut's Flavourcode launch puts a major competitor ahead in controlled cocoa fermentation for flavour, so Belcolade should benchmark it and speed up its own fermentation-flavour offer.

Planet A Foods is moving from cocoa-free chocolate into fibre-rich cocoa powder replacers, a direct challenge and possible partner for Belcolade's cocoa-saving solutions as Lindt's price cuts show cocoa costs easing.

Roquette (Wellence GF 1229 for gluten-free bread) and Palsgaard (powdered cake emulsifier) launched competing bakery and cake texture ingredients worth benchmarking against Puratos mixes and improvers.

US regulation is the key risk: a federal ultra-processed food definition, an FDA additive review, California sugar warnings and a proposed synthetic-dye ban could force reformulation of bread, cakes, glazes and chocolate.
New research on Peruvian cacao agroforests and Ghanaian climate adaptation shows shade and landscape management can raise cocoa yields, supporting Belcolade's sustainable sourcing work.

items.title: Water distribution and gluten-network organization in frozen dough prepared with different yeast preparations: Implications for steamed bread quality
items.summary: Study of how different yeast preparations affect water distribution and gluten-network structure in frozen dough for steamed bread.
items.why: Frozen-dough yeast choice and gluten stability are relevant to Puratos frozen-dough improvers and yeast-related solutions.

items.title: Caracterización organoléptica del cacao ecuatoriano: una revisión de la influencia del genotipo, ambiente y manejo poscosecha
items.summary: Review of how genotype, growing environment and post-harvest fermentation and drying shape the flavour of Ecuadorian Nacional and CCN-51 cocoa.
items.why: Useful background for Belcolade origin chocolates and its controlled cocoa-fermentation work on fine-flavour Ecuadorian cocoa.

items.title: Yeast Ingredient Market To 2035: Clean-Label Demand and Bakery Expansion Drive Growth - News and Statistics
items.summary: Market report forecasting yeast ingredient growth to 2035, driven by clean-label demand and bakery expansion.
items.why: Confirms clean-label demand as a growth driver for yeast and fermentation ingredients in bakery, supporting Puratos sourdough and clean-label improver positioning.

items.title: Adapt or Perish? Local stakeholders’ responses to climate change in Ghana’s cocoa-growing regions
items.summary: Focus groups in Ghana's cocoa regions show supply-chain actors see pests, erratic rain and soil decline from climate change and call for more adaptation support.
items.why: Climate stress on Ghanaian cocoa is a supply risk for Belcolade and relevant to Cacao-Trace style farmer support programmes.
entities: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology

items.title: Integrating local and landscape management promotes biodiversity, multifunctionality and yields in tropical agroforests
items.summary: Field study in Peruvian Amazon cacao agroforests finds 30% shade-tree cover in forested landscapes maximises both biodiversity and yields.
items.why: Practical evidence for sustainable cocoa sourcing programmes: shade and landscape management can raise yields without biodiversity loss, useful for Belcolade's farmer programmes.
entities: Universidad Nacional Agraria de la Selva

items.title: The effect of food taxes in the UK on health and economic outcomes, and equity: a modelling study.
items.summary: Modelling study of UK taxes on sugary snacks and cakes or on foods high in fat, sugar or salt, estimating health gains and reformulation effects.
items.why: A UK tax on cakes and sugary snacks would push sweet-goods customers towards sugar reduction; keep sugar-reduced patisserie and chocolate solutions ready for UK markets.
